title: PromoContent
description: Promo content: one offer with the discount as a badge, the heading, the deadline as text, a description, an optional promo code, one action and a picture. One object is valid in every promo layout (the picture at the end, at the start, on top).

badge.description: the discount as a short pill (-20%); empty: no badge

deadline.description: the deadline of the offer as it is shown (until 31 December)

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

image.description: address of the picture; none: the placeholder
